purpose: Explicit task-profile projection of the frozen public extraction rules; contains no gold targets, groups, contrasts, reviews, or private mappings.

conditionalRepresentation.root: first primary action in the main clause
conditionalRepresentation.consequences: remaining coordinated actions as nested consequences of the root
conditionalRepresentation.conditionAttachment: condition attaches to the root conditional clause

encodingPolicy.explicitQuantityUnit: preserve exactly; for seven times use {type: quantity, value: 7, unit: times}

modalityPolicy: obligation and permission are distinct; preserve explicit modality on root and coordinated consequences; lexical negation uses negated=true
